name: google-cloud
description: Search projects and storage; inspect billing accounts and query billing exports

io.github.personaljarvis.post_install_hint_md: Connect opens Google sign-in. Authorization is saved independently of Cloud API availability. Limited access means your account or project needs the corresponding API enabled or permissions granted. Billing queries require an existing export and may incur provider query charges.
io.github.personaljarvis.longevity_note: Google OAuth apps in Testing may lose refresh access after seven days; production apps follow account policy.
